data.one_liner: Bind screen activation to proximity sensor and detect proximity events in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that binds screen activation to the device proximity sensor. It allows detecting proximity events and checking if proximity locking is supported or available on the current device.
use_when: You want to turn off or lock the screen when an object is close to the proximity sensor
You need to listen to proximity sensor state changes on mobile devices
avoid_when: You are building for non-mobile platforms where proximity sensors are absent
You need general sensor access beyond proximity
strengths: Simple API to toggle active proximity locking
Checks sensor availability for iOS and Android
weaknesses: Availability depends on hardware support on Android
